/* BizHourMapper.getDaysList */
SELECT d.STORE_CD, s.STORE_NM , s.OWNER_NM, s.SYS_STAT_FG , d.DAY_FG , d.SEQ , d.START_TIME , d.END_TIME , SUBSTR(d.START_TIME, 1, 2) AS START_HOUR , SUBSTR(d.START_TIME, 3, 2) AS START_MS , SUBSTR(d.END_TIME, 1, 2) AS END_HOUR , SUBSTR(d.END_TIME, 3, 2) AS END_MS
FROM TB_MS_STORE_BIZHOUR_DAYS d , TB_MS_STORE s WHERE d.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND s.STORE_CD = d.STORE_CD
AND d.STORE_CD IN (${storeCdQuery})
ORDER BY d.STORE_CD, d.DAY_FG, d.SEQ
mapper.insert: /* BizHourMapper.insertDays */ INSERT INTO TB_MS_STORE_BIZHOUR_DAYS ( HQ_OFFICE_CD, STORE_CD, DAY_FG, SEQ, START_TIME, END_TIME, REG_DT, REG_ID, MOD_DT, MOD_ID ) VALUES ( #{hqOfficeCd}, #{storeCd}, #{dayFg}, #{seq}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{regDt}, #{regId}, #{modDt}, #{modId} )
mapper.select:
/* BizHourMapper.getSpecificList */
SELECT sp.STORE_CD, s.STORE_NM , s.OWNER_NM, s.SYS_STAT_FG , sp.BIZ_DATE , sp.SEQ , sp.BIZ_FG , sp.START_TIME , sp.END_TIME , sp.REMARK , SUBSTR(sp.START_TIME, 1, 2) AS START_HOUR , SUBSTR(sp.START_TIME, 3, 2) AS START_MS , SUBSTR(sp.END_TIME, 1, 2) AS END_HOUR , SUBSTR(sp.END_TIME, 3, 2) AS END_MS
FROM TB_MS_STORE_BIZHOUR_SPECIFIC sp , TB_MS_STORE s WHERE sp.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND s.STORE_CD = sp.STORE_CD
AND sp.STORE_CD IN (${storeCdQuery})
ORDER BY sp.STORE_CD, sp.BIZ_DATE, sp.SEQ
mapper.insert: /* BizHourMapper.insertSpecific */ INSERT INTO TB_MS_STORE_BIZHOUR_SPECIFIC ( HQ_OFFICE_CD, STORE_CD, BIZ_DATE, SEQ, BIZ_FG, START_TIME, END_TIME, REMARK, REG_DT, REG_ID, MOD_DT, MOD_ID ) VALUES ( #{hqOfficeCd}, #{storeCd}, #{bizDate}, #{seq}, #{bizFg}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{remark}, #{regDt}, #{regId}, #{modDt}, #{modId} )
